senses.gloss: m. (דרר, v. דור) [the object around which the question revolves,] stake, risk. ד׳ דממון fixed sum.
units: Targ. Esth. IV, 7.—In Talm. ד׳ דממונא money at stake, eventual loss.
<cite ref="Chagigah 21b:3">Ḥag. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דטומאה מדאורייתא</he> an eventual violation of the Biblical law of purity; <cite ref="Niddah 6a:19">Nidd. 6ᵃ</cite>
